summary: This is a Scientific Research Publishing (SCIRP) reference page showing that the Schlumberger Oilfield Glossary entry for 'lean gas' has been cited by a 2016 Energy and Power Engineering article on associated gas utilization in Nigeria. The page also lists several related SCIRP articles on oilfield topics such as resistivity surveying, oilfield GIS, sterane and triterpane analysis, and marginal oilfield maintenance. Most of the page is site navigation, contact details, and newsletter boilerplate, which was ignored.
one_line: SCIRP reference page listing articles that cite the Schlumberger Oilfield Glossary 'lean gas' entry, including a Nigerian associated gas turbine study.
key_facts: The Schlumberger Oilfield Glossary entry cited on this page is http://www.glossary.oilfield.slb.com/en/Terms/l/lean_gas.aspx.
The citing article is 'Associated Gas Utilization Using Gas Turbine Engine, Performance Implication—Nigerian Case Study' by Nnamdi Anosike, Abudssalam El-Suleiman, and Pericles Pilidis.
The citing article was published in Energy and Power Engineering, Vol.8 No.3, March 16, 2016.
The abstract states that Nigeria generates less than 54% of its electric power requirement.
The abstract states that most associated gas in Nigeria is continuously flared, with few portions re-injected into the reservoir for enhanced oil recovery (EOR).
The cited paper presents an analytical investigation of a gas turbine engine inspired by the GE LMS100 frame engine for onsite associated gas utilization in Nigeria.

Related article 'Comparison of Thickness and Depth Resolution Power of Wenner and Schlumberger Arrays: A Case Study of Temidire Quarters, Akure, Nigeria' by Igbagbo Adedotun Adeyemo, Bosede Taiwo Ojo, and Wasiu Olalekan Raheem appeared in the Journal of Geoscience and Environment Protection, Vol.5 No.3, March 31, 2017.

Related article 'Oilfield GIS Service Based on Mobile Platform' by Lingling Guo, Man Yuan, and Shaobin Hu appeared in Int'l J. of Communications, Network and System Sciences, Vol.3 No.4, April 30, 2010.
Related article 'Determination of Sterane and Triterpane in the Tamsagbulag Oilfield' appeared in Advances in Chemical Engineering and Science, Vol.1 No.3, July 22, 2011.

Related article 'Maintenance in Marginal Oilfield Production Facilities: A Review' by Olawale D. Adenuga, Ogheneruona E. Diemuodeke, and Ayoade O. Kuye appeared in World Journal of Engineering and Technology, Vol.10 No.4, September 27, 2022.
Related article 'Paleogeomorphology of Mixed Rock Deposition in KL16 Oilfield' by Peng Liu and coauthors appeared in Open Journal of Energy Efficiency, Vol.11 No.3, September 28, 2022.
